Use a Reader with UTF-8 (for example Files.newBufferedReader) for both bundles so verification and error messages operate on the real message text."

findings.title: i18next placeholders and ICU choice will render literally in React admin/account UIs
findings.body: This file is consumed by the React account UI, where interpolation uses the i18next syntax {{0}}, {{1}}, etc. (see all other keys in this file such as backTo=Back to {{app}}). The new value uses Java MessageFormat placeholders {0}, {1} and a {2,choice,...} segment. i18next will not interpolate those or evaluate the choice format, so users will see literal braces and format text instead of the actual counted value. The same addition was made in js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties.

findings.title: Lithuanian account message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new totpStep1 value is 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian, while this is a Lithuanian resource file. Lithuanian users will see Italian text in the OTP setup instructions instead of the translated instruction.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new loginTotpStep1 value is 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian, while this is a Lithuanian resource file. Lithuanian users will see Italian text in the OTP setup instructions instead of the translated instruction.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese account message replaced with Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The new totpStep1 value '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：' uses Traditional Chinese characters (手機, 應用程式), but this is the Simplified Chinese locale file. Simplified Chinese users will see Traditional Chinese text mixed into the otherwise Simplified Chinese UI.

findings.title: Diff substring can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when prefix and suffix overlap
findings.body: The common-prefix/common-suffix loop computes start and end independently. If the sanitized and original values differ only in a middle region and the common suffix overlaps the common prefix (for example with repeated or symmetric text), end can become greater than length - start, so value.substring(start, value.length() - end) is called with an end index before the start index. This throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and crashes the Maven verifier instead of reporting the actual 'Illegal HTML' difference.

findings.title: PropertyResourceBundle is loaded with ISO-8859-1 instead of UTF-8
findings.body: PropertyResourceBundle created from FileInputStream uses Properties.load(InputStream), which decodes bytes as ISO-8859-1. The Keycloak message properties are UTF-8 and contain raw non-Latin scripts such as Chinese, Arabic, and Cyrillic. Both the target and English bundles are therefore decoded to mojibake before sanitization and before any violation text is generated. Use a Reader with UTF-8 (for example Files.newBufferedReader) for both bundles so verification and error messages operate on the real message text.
